user.title: Connect to a TRO.Y 2 controller
user.description: Enter your TRO.Y 2 controller address. Home Assistant will validate the controller and discover its shades automatically.

data_description.host: Enter the local IP address or hostname. A DHCP reservation or static IP is recommended.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the TRO.Y 2 controller. Check the address and network connection.
error.discovery_failed: The controller responded, but Home Assistant could not read its shade list. Try again in a moment.
error.no_shades: The controller did not report any shades. Add a shade in TRO.Y 2, then try again.

abort.already_configured: This TRO.Y 2 controller is already configured.

set_wired_speeds.name: Set wired shade speeds
set_wired_speeds.description: Set the persistent up, down, and slow rolling speeds for an RS485 shade.

up_speed.name: Up speed
up_speed.description: Rolling speed used while opening the shade.

down_speed.name: Down speed
down_speed.description: Rolling speed used while closing the shade.

slow_speed.name: Slow speed
slow_speed.description: Rolling speed used by the motor's slow movement mode.
